verdict.scope_summary: The largest in-scope effect is the complete secondary-region canary and conditional rollback branch, including the primary-to-secondary same-revision handoff, regional-only rollback, and shared-metric escalation to both-region rollback. Widening production and moving governance intact were necessary accommodations for that added path. The only out-of-scope effect is removal of the existing p7 'healthy windows' label, a minor local loss of explicitness that does not alter the prior architecture.
